event.description: Remove lowest-norm residual LayerNorm bias group
event.proposal: Family: normalization. Current retained frontier is 3,360 parameters at 99.070000%, a +0.070000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There has been 1 prior attempt in this family. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0018, final-LayerNorm bias removal at 3,360 parameters and 99.07% official accuracy; there is no failed in-family result. Retained bias inspection ranks blocks.1.ln1.bias lowest by L2 norm at 0.2636, versus 0.3906, 0.6519, and 0.6638 for the other residual LayerNorm biases. Hypothesis: this least-magnitude additive group is the safest remaining affine redundancy; deleting it via checkpoint surgery yields 3,344 parameters. This parameterization-preserving, importance-ranked ablation is more informative than the nearest untested all-bias or RMSNorm substitution because it isolates one empirically weakest group under only seven-case qualification slack.
